name: Colpensiones
body: HSTS, nosniff, and a robots.txt that names AI answer crawlers like OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot and lets them in. But plain http://www.colpensiones.gov.co/ answers 503 instead of redirecting to https.
lesson: Keep port 80 alive just to send a 301 to https. Old links and typed addresses still arrive there.
summary: www.colpensiones.gov.co scores 66 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: plain http serves the site without redirecting.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 503. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 20 pages send to more than one GA4 property. 20 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: 27 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: sede.colpensiones.gov.co (27). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.colpensiones.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /documentos/571/descarga-de-formularios/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: 47 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 791 ms
Every page has a meta description
